runs.final_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM prod p
JOIN prod_sub ps ON p.ref2 = ps.prdc_sbct_id
JOIN prod_cat pc ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id
WHERE pc.nm = 'Clothing'
  AND p.mk_flg = 1
  AND p.fnsh_gds_flg = 1

SELECT COUNT(p.prdc_id) AS product_count
FROM prod AS p
JOIN prod_sub AS ps ON p.ref2 = ps.prdc_sbct_id
JOIN prod_cat AS pc ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id
WHERE pc.nm = 'Clothing'
  AND p.mk_flg = 1
  AND p.fnsh_gds_flg = 1

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM prod p

JOIN prod_cat pc ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id
